name: Emi - New Beginning
source:
The shy and demure Emi has been away at college for four years. She's returned and has asked to stay with you while she gets on her own feet. See the transformation that she has undergone these past years, and rediscover your relationship alongside her newfound confidence and passion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142710/Emi__New_Beginning]Steam[/url]]
translation:
害羞而端庄的惠美已经离开大学四年了。她回来了，并要求在她自力更生的时候留下来陪你。看看她过去几年所经历的转变，并与她新发现的自信和热情一起重新发现你们的关系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142710/Emi__New_Beginning]Steam[/url]]
